newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Investors to set up the first Gulf Pacific Bank with a paid-in capital of $100 million, $80 million of which will be placed for private subscription.
- Iraqi investors deny intention to withdraw investments from Jordan.
- Jordan's economic growth is expected to drop to three percent this year.
- Islamic candidates maintain strength in Kuwait's election.
- Qatar's stock market to start operations in the first quarter of 1997.
- United Arab Emirates central bank studies plans to increase paid-in capital of new banks to 100 million dirhams.
